cases.observation: A real Finder drag acquired the guard lock, sent the 65,536-byte unknown-length PUT with a lock-token If predicate, received 201, then unlocked with 204. A later lock/read/unlock cycle returned the complete file. Direct cloud reading and a fresh remount both matched the source SHA-256. The lock is explicitly scoped to the controlled WebDAV session and is not represented as a persistent cloud lock.
